Status update: SRE has confirmed a quota-translation mismatch between the tenant-level quota map and the downstream enforcement layer for requests routed to our eu-west-1 fallback pool. Essentially, when regional routing overflowed into the fallback pool we applied a default token-window that was lower than Starlit’s dedicated quota mapping — causing abrupt 429s for a subset of concurrent flows.

Mitigation taken (09:50 PT): temporary override to align fallback pool window with tenant mapping + enabled a secondary buffer for ongoing bursts. We’re monitoring; early signs show errors dropping back to baseline.

Next steps: 1) Run a permanent mapping sync and redeploy quota config (ETA: 3 hours). 2) Deliver a post-incident runbook for Starlit and offer a credit for impacted token usage. 3) Confirm whether the fallback routing should be excluded for your critical routes (CS will follow up on config opt-outs).

Karthik
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
